notes: Unleash Fury, printed 'Double the power of target creature until end of turn.' CR 701.10a/b: doubling MODIFIES (gets +X/+0, X = its power as the spell resolves), it never SETS P/T. A 2/2 with a +1/+1 counter (Basri's Solidarity) is 3/3; doubled it must be 6/3 (+3/+0), with the counter still on it. A set-to-(2*P)/T effect folded before the counter layer would read 7/4.
